messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Sofia from Azure asked for a single artifact bundle for the marketplace review: SOC2 pdf, recent pen-test summary, and a short attestation. timeline = EOW next Fri. Who can own?
Raj (Security): I can lead the pen-test artifact side. Need clarification: they want full report or redacted summary + remediation tracker?
Sofia (Marketplace Team): They accept redacted reports but require an Appendix A with mitigations and CVE references. Also need a signed attestation (PDF) with the pen-test vendor's contact.
Mei (Legal): We should use the standard attestation template (Legal attestation v2). I'll attach later. Any PII in reports must be redacted before upload.
Tom (Eng): For redaction, we can run the static scrubbing job on the internal evidence bucket and then produce a presigned URL. I'll queue a job and share steps.
Raj (Security): Plan: 1) Get raw pen-test from vendor. 2) Run redaction (PII, customer data, internal IPs). 3) Produce summary + findings.json (structured) + remediation timeline doc. 4) Sign attestation.
Anna (Partnerships): Nice. Can we put a simple runbook in this thread so Sofia can grab it? Keep it minimal, step-by-step.
Tom (Eng): Runbook (short):
```
# pen-test evidence runbook
1. Vendor submits raw_report.pdf to s3://redwood-evidence/inbound/marketplace/azure/<vendor>-<ts>.pdf
2. Run redaction job: /bin/run_redact --input raw_report.pdf --output redacted.pdf --rules marketplace
3. Generate summary: /bin/generate_summary --input redacted.pdf --output summary.md
4. Produce findings.json via vuln-parser: vuln-parser redacted.pdf > findings.json
5. Upload artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/outbound/marketplace/azure/<listing>/ and request presign
6. Legal signs attestation (see Legal attestation v2 template)
7. Send presigned bundle to marketplace contact with checklist.csv attached
```
Raj (Security): Redaction rules: remove email addresses, phone numbers, internal hostnames, customer data, and any screenshots with customer content. Validate manual spot-check by another engineer.
Mei (Legal): Attestation must include: scope, date, vendor name, signer name and title, and statement of redaction. I'll prepare a fillable PDF and post it here.
Sofia (Marketplace Team): For Azure Marketplace specifically: they want a single zip <= 250MB named using the pattern: redwood_azure_evidence_<listing>_<date>.zip. Inside: redacted.pdf, summary.md, findings.json, attestation.pdf, checklist.csv. Also include a short "scope.txt" with enabled products and regions.
Anna (Partnerships): Who will own uploading the final bundle to the marketplace portal?
Sofia (Marketplace Team): We usually ask partners to upload, but we can upload on their behalf if we provide presigned link and contact info. For this listing, Redwood should upload — we'll need a point of contact.
Tom (Eng): I'll generate presigned URLs. Example command: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/outbound/marketplace/azure/redwood_azure_evidence_listing123_2026-04-02.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Tom (Eng): I'll also set object ACL to private and add lifecycle TTL of 90 days.
Raj (Security): After upload, we need to keep an internal copy for 365 days per policy. Add record to compliance tracker with vendor name and report hash.
Mei (Legal): Also add a short note about export controls if pen-test included firmware/hardware components.
Anna (Partnerships): OK action items: Raj = get vendor report + run redaction (owner). Tom = run redaction job + create presign + push bundle (upload owner). Mei = prepare attestation template + confirm redaction language. Sofia = handoff to marketplace contact and confirm upload method. I'll coordinate external comms.
Sofia (Marketplace Team): Confirming timeline: draft bundle by Thu, internal review Fri AM, upload Fri PM. If anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Raj (Security): I'll start vendor follow-up now. Vendor contact: pentest-co@example.com (asked to provide dates and raw PDF).
Mei (Legal): Attestation template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/legal/attestation_v2.pdf
Tom (Eng): Kickoff job queued: job-id: evidence-redact-20260402-01. I'll post presign when done.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks all — putting this in the calendar and notifying the listing manager. evidence-bot: create checklist card for marketplace_evidence/listing123.
evidence-bot: Created checklist card #EVID-4122 with assignees Raj, Tom, Mei, Anna.
Sofia (Marketplace Team): Thanks — I'll wait for presign and then confirm once portal upload completes. :rocket:
